name: Custom Lunch Bag
description:
FEATURES

 

  • Best Material: Made of polyester
  • Fabric: 100% Polyester 
  • GSM: Approximately 200g/m2
  • The Multi-functional of the lunch bag includes:
  1. Food Storage: The primary function of a lunch bag is to store and keep your food fresh, making it an essential tool for carrying meals and snacks.
  2. Insulation: Many lunch bags come with thermal insulation, helping to maintain the temperature of your food, whether you want to keep it warm or cold.
  3. Portability: Lunch bags are designed for easy portability, often featuring handles, shoulder straps, or even backpack-style straps for hands-free carrying.
  4. Eco-Friendly: Reusable lunch bags contribute to reducing waste generated by disposable containers and plastic bags, making them an eco-friendly choice.
  5. Work and School: Whether you're going to work, school, or any other destination, a lunch bag ensures you have a convenient way to carry your meals.
  6. Travel Companion: Lunch bags are useful during travel for carrying snacks, fruits, or even small essentials you want to keep handy.
  • Customization: Lunch bags can be customized with your name, logo, or favorite designs, adding a personal touch. Our UV-printed technology will print designs on one side of the pot.
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends. You can gift it to your favorite celebrities, friends, family members, lovers

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xLunch Bag

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may differ slightly from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
